```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: perf-benchmark-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          path: pr

      - name: Checkout main branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          path: main

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies for PR
        working-directory: pr
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build PR
        working-directory: pr
        run: npm run build

      - name: Install dependencies for main
        working-directory: main
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build main
        working-directory: main
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run benchmark
        id: benchmark
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail

          run_bench() {
            local dir=$1
            local label=$2
            local times=()
            for i in {1..7}; do
              if [ $i -le 2 ]; then
                echo "Warmup $i for $label"
                time -p npx repomix pack . > /dev/null 2>&1
              else
                echo "Measured $i for $label"
                t=$( { time -p npx repomix pack . > /dev/null 2>&1; } 2>&1 | grep real | awk '{print $2}' )
                times+=("$t")
              fi
            done
            IFS=$'\n' sorted=($(sort -n <<<"${times[*]}"))
            median=${sorted[${#sorted[@]}/2]}
            echo "${label}=${median}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          }

          run_bench pr "PR branch"
          run_bench main "main branch"

      - name: Calculate diff
        id: diff
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail
          pr_time=$(echo "${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.PR branch }}" | awk -F= '{print $2}')
          main_time=$(echo "${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.main branch }}" | awk -F= '{print $2}')
          diff=$(echo "$pr_time - $main_time" | bc -l)
          percent=$(echo "scale=4; ($diff / $main_time) * 100" | bc -l)
          echo "pr_time=$pr_time" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "main_time=$main_time" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "diff=$diff" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "percent=$percent" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post comment
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          #!/usr/bin/env bash
          set -euo pipefail
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          OWNER=${{ github.repository_owner }}
          REPO=${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          MARKER="<!-- perf-benchmark -->"

          body=$(cat <<EOF
          ${MARKER}
          | | Time |
          |---|---:|
          | PR branch | ${{ steps.diff.outputs.pr_time }}s |
          | main branch | ${{ steps.diff.outputs.main_time }}s |
          | **Diff** | **$(printf '%+.2f' ${{ steps.diff.outputs.diff }})s ($(printf '%+.1f' ${{ steps.diff.outputs.percent }})%)** |
          EOF
          )

          comment_id=$(gh api repos/$OWNER/$REPO/issues/$PR_NUMBER/comments --jq ".[] | select(.body | contains(\"$MARKER\")) | .id")
          if [ -z "$comment_id" ]; then
            gh api -X POST repos/$OWNER/$REPO/issues/$PR_NUMBER/comments -f body="$body"
          else
            gh api -X PATCH repos/$OWNER/$REPO/issues/comments/$comment_id -f body="$body"
          fi
```
